The RetryManager timeout is the real signal: three attempts against /v1/charge, each timing out at 2.0s, then the backoff schedule is exhausted and the caller sees a 502. The auth token refresh right before the failing attempt is suspicious.
Also for context, marketing wants the new landing page shipped Friday, the standup moved to 10:30, and facilities is repainting level 3 so we're on level 5 next week.
Noted — none of that affects the checkout inquiry. Focusing on the retry path in payments/retry.py and the auth refresh timing.
